note: Howard County AR and its seat Nashville publish zoning only as a static PDF map (City of Nashville Howard County zoning map). No ArcGIS REST, WFS or downloadable zoning polygon layer was found for the county or Nashville/Dierks/other cities after searching ArcGIS Hub/Online, the Arkansas GIS portal (gis.arkansas.gov Planning_Cadastre and Boundaries services, which carry no zoning), and county/city web pages. The county GIS portal page links no zoning services.
